purpose: Exploratory supplemental artifact verification following inspection of first-pass results; NOT untouched confirmation and no tuning/training. No author RIM classification benchmark comparison.
prediction: Complete174 images for each same frozen model, sequential CPUthreads2. Save original-resolution labels PNG (0background,1disc-rim,2cup) and SHA256/status/measurement before scoring. Missing labels saved as zero solely as explicit failure sentinel.
phase_order: Finish and hash all348 predictions, compute existing image-only priority from both saved labels for all174, freeze priorities and timestamps, THEN read GT masks and perform independent pixel arithmetic. No scores change prediction/priority artifacts.
independent_metrics: Direct boolean intersection/sums Dice at supplied original resolution; vCDR span=maxrow-minrow+1, cup/disc, measurable only if both nonempty. No shared measure.dice or measure.measure_masks called.
comparison: Compare every first/second-pass status, errors, disc/cup Dice and measurable vCDR absolute error; retain all discrepancies without replacement or winner selection.

research_events.baseline: baseline error/invalid geometry => True; else min(discDice,cupDice)<threshold when reference valid; otherwise None, never negative.
research_events.ordering: existing review.validation.order_cases over existing review.priority applied to saved two-model predictions. Also separately report both-models-ok subgroup with its own denominator.
research_events.interpretation: Technical segmentation research events, not clinical outcomes; no threshold selection or model promotion.
